verdict.rationale: JumpCloud has a first-party Conditional Access capability. It covers two of the four named signals: trusted network and device compliance, which revoke access automatically. The evidence does not show location or risk-signal conditions, and does not show policies scoped per app and per group. missing for 10: location-based conditions, risk-signal-driven policies, documented per-app and per-group policy scoping, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, access decisions weigh context — network, device, location, and risk signals drive conditional policies per app and group

citations.quote: when users aren’t on a trusted network and/or if a device falls out of compliance, access is revoked instantly—no manual intervention required.
